verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds
Master of the Day of Judgment
Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help

verses.ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray
